posting.title: Software Engineer
posting.description_text:
Brightfield Labs is growing fast. We are looking for a Software Engineer who loves solving problems.
You will write clean code, collaborate with teammates, review code and debug issues.
You have: strong problem solving skills, good communication, experience with modern programming languages and cloud platforms.
We value ownership and curiosity.
